visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up shot of steaming hot, fluffy white rice in a metallic cooking pot. Large white captions are centered on the screen. (2) The shot transitions to raw white rice grains at the bottom of the same pot. A clear stream of water is poured from an unseen container over the grains. (3) The pot is shown on an indoor stovetop, covered with a transparent glass lid. Droplets of condensation are visible on the lid as the water inside begins to boil. (4) The lid is removed to reveal the rice boiling vigorously in starchy, opaque white water with many bubbles. (5) As the cooking progresses, the water level decreases significantly, leaving the rice visible with thick steam rising from the pot. (6) The cooked rice is shown again, now with most of the water absorbed, creating small steam vents on the surface. (7) The pot is covered with a solid metallic lid to let the rice steam. (8) A hand enters the frame and uses a spoon to drizzle a dark, savory minced meat sauce over the fresh white rice. (9) A young woman with long dark hair and a grey t-shirt is seen in a medium close-up shot. She takes a large bite of the rice and meat sauce from a portable camping-style container, smiles happily, and gives a enthusiastic thumbs-up to the camera while wearing a grey smartwatch.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a simple, practical guide for travelers to cook rice using a basic pot when a rice cooker is unavailable abroad, emphasizing home-cooked comfort.
